I'm trying to figure out the likely durations of tracks, estimating around 49 to 54 seconds, or maybe 2 to 3 minutes. It's safer to aim for about 10 seconds when seeking. For fast-forwarding, I think I should play first, then seek to around 20 seconds, though shorter could work too. I'm also estimating opus sizes to be around 500k, with a bit rate of about 128k and a duration of perhaps 60 to 90 seconds. Checking the manifest.json for exact durations sounds like a good idea!
